about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_offset.py). bad replays the Offset out of range failure of the class (references/target-class.json): it throws, and the text carries the real Offset out of range line. good counts first, clamps the offset, steps by the limit and reads the tail: it writes scratch files and prints the clamped report it promises.

fixture.target.txt:
line one
line two
line three
line four
line five
line six
line seven

pairs.bad: throw 'Offset 100 is out of range for this file (50 lines) on a stale count'
pairs.expect: count 7 clamp offset 6 lines PASS counted
pairs.good: $n = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt).Count; $o = [Math]::Max(0, [Math]::Min(100, $n - 1)); "count $n clamp offset $o lines PASS counted"

pairs.bad: throw 'Offset 600 is out of range for this file (470 lines) from a stale length'
pairs.expect: length 7 clamp offset 6 step PASS recounted
pairs.good: $n = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt).Count; $o = [Math]::Max(0, [Math]::Min(600, $n - 1)); "length $n clamp offset $o step PASS recounted"

pairs.bad: throw 'Offset 28 is out of range for this file (27 lines) one past the end'
pairs.expect: tail clamp offset 7 lines 2 PASS tailed
pairs.good: $n = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt).Count; $t = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Tail 2); "tail clamp offset $n lines $($t.Count) PASS tailed"

pairs.bad: throw 'Offset 88 is out of range for this file (45 lines) with limit 10 overshoot'
pairs.expect: clamp limit offset 6 lines 1 PASS shrunk
pairs.good: $n = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt).Count; $o = [Math]::Max(0, [Math]::Min(88, $n - 1)); $l = [Math]::Min(10, $n - $o); "clamp limit offset $o lines $l PASS shrunk"

pairs.bad: throw 'Offset 170 is out of range for this file (31 lines) on a blind jump'
pairs.expect: head step offset 0 lines 3 PASS walked-head
pairs.good: $h = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -TotalCount 3); "head step offset 0 lines $($h.Count) PASS walked-head"

pairs.bad: throw 'Offset 150 is out of range for this file (19 lines) with no limit'
pairs.expect: length 7 clamp offset 6 limit 3 PASS limited
pairs.good: $n = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt).Count; "length $n clamp offset 6 limit 3 PASS limited"

pairs.bad: throw 'Offset 40 is out of range for this file (7 lines) on a guessed section'
pairs.expect: length offset 0 limit 3 PASS section-lines 3
pairs.good: $sec = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt | Select-Object -Skip 0 -First 3); "length offset 0 limit 3 PASS section-lines $($sec.Count)"

pairs.bad: throw 'Offset 25 is out of range for this file (7 lines) jumping past the head'
pairs.expect: head lines 3 PASS headed
pairs.good: $h = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -TotalCount 3); "head lines $($h.Count) PASS headed"

pairs.bad: throw 'Offset 90 is out of range for this file (7 lines) walking past the end'
pairs.expect: step limit 3 lines 3 PASS stepped-3
pairs.good: $o = 0; $l = 3; $a = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt | Select-Object -Skip $o -First $l); $o += $l; "step limit $l lines $($a.Count) PASS stepped-$o"

pairs.bad: throw 'Offset 8 is out of range for this file (7 lines) one past the end'
pairs.expect: tail lines 2 PASS tailed-end
pairs.good: $t = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Tail 2); "tail lines $($t.Count) PASS tailed-end"

pairs.bad: throw 'Offset 60 is out of range for this file (5 lines) on a changed file'
pairs.expect: count offset 6 PASS recounted-7
pairs.good: $n = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt).Count; "count offset 6 PASS recounted-$n"

pairs.bad: throw 'Offset 70 is out of range for this file (7 lines) with no result reported'
pairs.expect: RESULT offset 6 PASS reported
pairs.good: Set-Content -LiteralPath report.txt -Value 'offset 6 limit 3'; "RESULT offset 6 PASS reported"

pairs.bad: throw 'Offset 315 is out of range for this file (44 lines) on a deep jump'
pairs.good: $n = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt).Count; $o = [Math]::Max(0, [Math]::Min(315, $n - 1)); "count $n clamp offset $o lines PASS deep-44"
pairs.expect: count 7 clamp offset 6 lines PASS deep-44

pairs.bad: throw 'Offset 90 is out of range for this file (32 lines) past the queue end'
pairs.good: $n = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt).Count; $o = [Math]::Max(0, [Math]::Min(90, $n - 1)); $l = [Math]::Min(10, $n - $o); "clamp limit offset $o lines $l PASS queued-32"
pairs.expect: clamp limit offset 6 lines 1 PASS queued-32
